lines.text: Same age as me, not with!
Many learners say: He is the same age with me.
Better: He is the same age as me.
As! She is the same age as my sister.

data.wrong: He is the same age with me.
data.right: He is the same age as me.
data.memory: He is the same age as me.

quiz.stem: She is the same age ___ my sister.

native.tip: Türkçede “benimle aynı yaşta” (“ile”) deriz; İngilizcede “with” değil “as” gelir.
native.caption: “He is the same age with me” mi diyorsun? 😅 Türkçedeki “ile” burada “with” olmaz; “the same age as” denir. Doğrusu “He is the same age as me.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.

en.tip: Use “as”, not “with”: “He is the same age as me.”
en.caption: Do you say “He is the same age with me”? 😅 After “the same age” we say “as”, not “with”. The right sentence is “He is the same age as me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
